verdict.rationale: The CLI exposes some engine-level load parameters, including GPU offload ratio (`--gpu=max|auto|0.0-1.0`) and context length on `lms load`, and the app mentions managing model configurations. Nothing documents memory locking, mmap, or other deeper llama.cpp/MLX knobs. One community report also says CUDA acceleration couldn't be set before loading a model. Missing for 10: documented mlock/mmap overrides, a broader set of low-level engine parameters (threads, batch size, KV cache options), and hands-on corroboration that power-users can override defaults.
